title: IPC is going to conduct PT round 01/2026 in Qualitative test for specific pathogens (Present/Absent of Salmonella & Shigella in 10 ml and Escherichia coli & Staphylococcus aureus in 1 ml of sample) in Biological Discipline (Drugs & Pharmaceuticals).
bodyHtml:
IPC is going to conduct PT round 01/2026 in Qualitative test for specific pathogens (Present/Absent of Salmonella & Shigella in 10 ml and Escherichia coli & Staphylococcus aureus in 1 ml of sample) in Biological Discipline (Drugs & Pharmaceuticals).

You are requested to find the attached Registration form, Intimation Letter and send your consent with filled registration form by e-mail at qualityassurance-ipc@gov.in on or before 20th May 2026.

Please click to download Intimation letter.PDF (opens in a new tab)

Please click to download Registration Form.PDF (opens in a new tab)
